Notice
This advertisement is a notice of a potential opportunity. This Request for Expressions of Interest (the  advertisement ) is not a solicitation for offers, nor is it a request for proposals. Respondents are advised that the Government assumes no responsibility to award an Enhanced-Use Lease (EUL) based upon responses to this advertisement.  

This Sources Sought Notice is to identify potential sources for information and planning purposes only and is not intended to pre-qualify or disqualify any potential Respondents.  
The purpose of this Sources Sought is to conduct market research to determine if there are responsible and qualified entities interested in redeveloping the assets described in Section III and if yes, what potential reuse options exist.  
The information gained from this Sources Sought will be used to assist the Government in determining if this development opportunity can be competitive and/or a total Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) or Veteran-Owned Small Business (VOSB) Set-Aside. The Government will use this information to determine the best acquisition strategy for this procurement and to inform related asset management decision-making. 
The Government requests that interested parties respond to this Notice with the specific information requested in Section V of this Notice and identify their small business status. VA is particularly interested in SDVOSB/VOSB respondents  capabilities to perform a minimum of 51% of the development opportunity described in this Notice.  
Developers responding to this market research should be aware that responding to this advertisement may not ensure that they qualify for any underlying future solicitation or contract award. 
Responding to this Sources Sought Notice is NOT a prerequisite to respond to any future subsequent solicitations.  
The Government will not reimburse participants for any expenses associated with their participation in this Sources Sought.
The Government cannot provide any warranty, expressed or implied, as to the accuracy, reliability or completeness of the information contained in this Notice.  

Overview and Objectives
The United States Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), under its Enhanced-Use Leasing (EUL) authority (38 U.S.C. Â§Â§ 8161- 8169, as amended), is seeking expressions of interest from qualified developers, including SDVOSBs and VOSBs, to serve as a  Developer  for purposes of developing supportive housing or other uses that directly or indirectly benefit Veterans (e.g., general affordable housing, skilled nursing facilities, technical job training centers, research facilities, mixed-use, other).

VA s EUL authority allows VA to outlease land and improvements to selected developers (i.e., Lessees) to provide housing and/or other uses that directly or indirectly benefit Veterans. Such leases can have a term of up to 99 years. VA s Office of Asset Enterprise Management (OAEM) administers the EUL Program.

An EUL is a long-term ground lease of underutilized VA-owned land or buildings to a non-federal entity (Developer). Under the EUL program, the Developer secures a long-term leasehold interest with VA for the subject property. This deal structure enables developers to finance, design, develop, renovate/construct, operate, and maintain improvements on VA property to directly or indirectly benefit Veterans. 

The objective of this development opportunity is to repurpose assets at the Lake Baldwin VA Medical Clinic under VA s EUL Program to the benefit of Veterans. Respondents should consider the following as they formulate responses to this Notice: 

Lease-back by VA or other Federal government entities is not permissible, and financing cannot reflect a lease-back arrangement. The PACT Act does not nullify 38 U.S.C. Â§ 8162(b)(5), which states, "The terms of an enhanced-use lease may not provide for any acquisition, contract, demonstration, exchange, grant, incentive, procurement, sale, other transaction authority, service agreement, use agreement, lease, or lease-back by the Secretary or Federal Government.  
VA may only receive cash consideration for ground lease rent in an EUL (per 38 U.S.C. Â§ 8162(b)(3)(B)). This means VA cannot receive any in-kind consideration or free/discounted services as part of a new EUL agreement. However, projects may provide free or discounted services to individual Veterans or Veteran Service Organizations, and the Secretary may enter into an EUL without receiving consideration per U.S.C. Â§ 8162(b)(3)(C).   

Additional information on the VA s EUL program and sample EUL projects may be obtained at: http://www.va.gov/assetmanagement/. 

Development Scope
The intent of this Notice is to determine if there are experienced developers, including SDVOSB or VOSB developers, that can develop the subject assets in accordance with VA s EUL authority.  

The Developer would undertake all necessary investigative activities to develop the selected assets at the Lake Baldwin VA Medical Clinic campus. VA is especially interested in development of supportive housing but will also consider other uses that benefit Veterans. The assets that may be redeveloped by a Developer include, but are not limited to, the following interconnected buildings (with current use in parentheses): 
Building 519 (Domiciliary)
Building 519a (Dining / education space in the first floor courtyard)
Building 520 (Domiciliary)
Building 520a (Domiciliary reception / elevator space in Northwest corner of the interconnected buildings)
Building 521 (Domiciliary)
Building 522 (Domiciliary)
